GoalOptions.Label: Accelerate Incident Resolution
GoalOptions.Text: The primary goal is to significantly reduce Mean Time To Resolution (MTTR) for IT incidents. Success means incidents are diagnosed and resolved in minutes rather than hours or days, minimizing business disruption and associated costs. This directly impacts operational stability and customer satisfaction.

GoalOptions.Label: Enhance Operational Efficiency
GoalOptions.Text: The goal is to automate complex diagnostic tasks, freeing up valuable engineering resources. Success is measured by the reduction in manual effort required for root cause analysis, allowing teams to focus on proactive improvements and strategic initiatives. This boosts overall IT team productivity and morale.

GoalOptions.Label: Improve System Reliability
GoalOptions.Text: The objective is to proactively identify and address systemic issues before they cause major outages. Success is demonstrated by a measurable decrease in recurring incidents and a sustained improvement in the availability and performance of critical IT systems. This builds trust in the underlying infrastructure.

GoalOptions.Label: Demonstrate AI ROI
GoalOptions.Text: The goal is to clearly articulate the return on investment for the AI-powered RCA system. Success is shown through quantifiable benefits such as reduced downtime costs, optimized resource allocation, and improved service level agreement (SLA) adherence. This justifies the technology investment to stakeholders.

CriteriaOptions.Label: Technical Performance & Accuracy
Criteria: Accuracy of root cause identification across diverse incident types.
Latency and throughput of the data pipeline and AI inference.
Scalability of the system to handle peak data volumes.
Integration capabilities with existing IT monitoring and ticketing tools.

CriteriaOptions.Label: Business Impact & ROI
Criteria: Quantifiable reduction in Mean Time To Resolution (MTTR).
Demonstrable decrease in operational costs related to incident management.
Improvement in system uptime and service availability metrics.
Positive impact on customer satisfaction and business continuity.

CriteriaOptions.Label: Operational & Security Compliance
Criteria: Adherence to data privacy and security standards (e.g., GDPR, SOC 2).
Auditability and traceability of the RCA process.
Robustness against system failures and data corruption.
Ease of deployment, management, and maintenance by IT operations teams.
